faq: Yes. You receive the full source code and we keep no rights to it. The module lives in your own repository or store, and another Magento developer can pick it up easily.
Will it work with Magento upgrades?

We build using Magento's extension points and avoid core edits, which is the best protection against upgrade problems. Major version upgrades can still need small changes, and we note which parts to test.
Can you fix or extend a third-party extension?
We can add features through plugins and overrides in a separate module, or fix small bugs in code you own. Editing a paid vendor extension directly can break its updates and license, so we avoid it.
Can you publish my module on the Marketplace?
We can prepare it to Marketplace standards, but Adobe reviews submissions and we cannot promise acceptance. Our price covers building the module for your store.
